market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: SOL currently trades well above $100, making $20 an extreme ~85%+ decline. While crypto crashes have occurred historically (e.g., SOL fell to ~$8 in late 2022), the current ecosystem strength and institutional interest reduce the odds of such a deep drawdown within the roughly 13-month window. I estimate a ~5% true probability versus the market's 9.5%, indicating the No side offers value.
evidence_points: Historical SOL low was $8 in Dec 2022 after FTX collapse, but structural support and adoption are much stronger now.
Binance SOL/USDT 1-minute candles rarely show flash-crash wicks of that magnitude without extreme market-wide panic.
Even in a prolonged bear market, SOL would likely find support above $20 given its DeFi and validator ecosystem.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of SOL price history and market structure
